script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The line about wanting something to stay put is generic and flat, with no clear comic payoff.
The pillar joke shifts from the picture of firmly embedded nails to being poked, so the comparison does not match the action in the text.
Firmly embedded does not necessarily mean the nails are all the way in; that adds a detail the text does not give.
The explanation repeats the answer and verse without adding much personality; it reads flat and generic.
The text says much study wearies the body, not that it takes too much study to do so.
